```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(DESeq2)
library(matrixStats)
library(ggdendro)
library(pheatmap)

load("Visium_Pain_clean.RData")  # loads experiment
experiment <- UpdateSeuratObject(experiment)
```

```{r}
### Region-wise DEG analysis Seurat v5

output_dir <- "02_1_region-wise DEG-Sv5"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


DefaultAssay(experiment) <- "Spatial"

all_regions <- sort(unique(experiment$labels))

deg_list <- list()


for (region in all_regions) {
  
  cat("Processing region:", region, "\n")
  
  region_obj <- subset(
    experiment,
    subset = labels == region
  )
  
  Idents(region_obj) <- "condition"
  
  
  # Skip if one condition is absent
  
  if (!all(c("sham", "SNI") %in%
           unique(as.character(Idents(region_obj))))) {
    
    cat("  Skipping", region, "- missing condition level\n")
    next
  }
  
  
  degs <- FindMarkers(
    object = region_obj,
    ident.1 = "SNI",
    ident.2 = "sham",
    assay = "Spatial",
    slot = "data",
    fc.slot = "data",
    test.use = "wilcox",
    min.pct = 0,
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    only.pos = FALSE
  )
  
  
  degs$gene <- rownames(degs)
  degs$region <- region
  
  deg_list[[region]] <- degs
}


# Combine outputs

deg_table_all <- bind_rows(deg_list)


degs_sig <- deg_table_all %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_val_adj),
    p_val_adj < 0.05
  )


degs_sig_fc <- deg_table_all %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_val_adj),
    p_val_adj < 0.05,
    abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25
  )


summarise_degs_by_region <- function(deg_table, all_regions) {
  
  deg_table %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    summarise(
      n_up_SNI = sum(avg_log2FC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_down_SNI = sum(avg_log2FC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_deg_total = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    right_join(
      data.frame(region = all_regions),
      by = "region"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_up_SNI = replace_na(n_up_SNI, 0L),
      n_down_SNI = replace_na(n_down_SNI, 0L),
      n_deg_total = replace_na(n_deg_total, 0L)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_deg_total))
}


deg_summary_sig <- summarise_degs_by_region(
  degs_sig,
  all_regions
)


deg_summary_sig_fc <- summarise_degs_by_region(
  degs_sig_fc,
  all_regions
)


write.csv(
  deg_table_all,
  file.path(output_dir, "deg_table_all_regions-Sv5.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  deg_summary_sig,
  file.path(output_dir, "deg_summary_sig-Sv5.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  deg_summary_sig_fc,
  file.path(output_dir, "deg_summary_sig_fc-Sv5.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
### DEG MAPPING ON SNI1

output_dir <- "02_2_DEG burden"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


deg_map <- setNames(deg_summary_sig_fc$n_deg_total, as.character(deg_summary_sig_fc$region))

experiment$deg_burden <- unname(
  deg_map[as.character(experiment$labels)]
)



### Identify the five regions with the highest DEG burden

top_regions <- deg_summary_sig_fc %>%
  arrange(desc(n_deg_total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(region)


### Obtain SNI1 spot coordinates and region labels

sni1_coordinates <- experiment@images$SNI1@coordinates %>%
  rownames_to_column("barcode") %>%
  left_join(
    experiment@meta.data %>%
      rownames_to_column("barcode") %>%
      select(
        barcode,
        labels
      ),
    by = "barcode"
  )


### Calculate centroid of each top region on SNI1

label_df <- sni1_coordinates %>%
  filter(
    labels %in% top_regions
  ) %>%
  group_by(labels) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(imagecol, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = mean(imagerow, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  experiment,
  images = "SNI1",
  features = "deg_burden",
  image.alpha = 0,
  pt.size.factor = 2000,
  crop = TRUE
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#fce4ec",
    high = "#ad1457",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(fill = "DEGs per region") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank()
  )

p

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir,"deg_burden_spatialplot.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

```{r}
### DEG BURDEN BARPLOT

output_dir <- "02_2_DEG burden"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


deg_summary_sig_fc_long <- deg_summary_sig_fc %>%
  dplyr::select(
    region,
    n_up_SNI,
    n_down_SNI
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      n_up_SNI,
      n_down_SNI
    ),
    names_to = "direction",
    values_to = "n_genes"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = recode(
      direction,
      n_up_SNI = "Up in SNI",
      n_down_SNI = "Down in SNI"
    ),
    region = factor(
      region,
      levels = rev(deg_summary_sig_fc$region)
    )
  )


p <- ggplot(
  deg_summary_sig_fc_long,
  aes(
    x = region,
    y = n_genes,
    fill = direction
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Down in SNI" = "#2166AC",
      "Up in SNI" = "#B2182B"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


p


ggsave(
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "deg_burden_barplot.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

```{r}
### VOLCANO PLOTS FOR TOP 5 REGIONS BY DEG BURDEN

output_dir <- "02_3_Volcano plots"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Top five regions based on significant DEGs with |log2FC| > 0.25
top5_regions <- deg_summary_sig_fc %>%
  arrange(desc(n_deg_total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(region)

top5_regions

volcano_plots <- list()

for (region_of_interest in top5_regions) {

  volcano_df <- deg_table_all %>%
    filter(region == region_of_interest) %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(p_val_adj + 1e-300),

      sig = case_when(
        p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.25  ~ "Up in SNI",
        p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -0.25 ~ "Down in SNI",
        TRUE                                  ~ "NS"
      )
    )

  # Label the 25 most significant genes that also pass the FC cutoff
  top_labels <- volcano_df %>%
    filter(
      p_val_adj < 0.05,
      abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
    slice_head(n = 25)

  p <- ggplot(
    volcano_df,
    aes(
      x = avg_log2FC,
      y = neg_log10_padj,
      color = sig
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 1.8,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Down in SNI" = "#2166AC",
        "Up in SNI"   = "#B2182B",
        "NS"          = "grey75"
      ),
      breaks = c(
        "Up in SNI",
        "Down in SNI",
        "NS"
      )
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = top_labels,
      aes(label = gene),
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = region_of_interest,
      x = expression(log[2] * " fold change (SNI vs sham)"),
      y = expression(-log[10] * " adjusted p-value"),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic()

  volcano_plots[[region_of_interest]] <- p

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0("volcano_plot_", region_of_interest, ".pdf")
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 6,
    height = 5,
    units = "in",
    device = cairo_pdf
  )
}

volcano_plots
```

```{r}
### HEATMAP: TOP 5 REGIONS × UNION OF TOP 10 DEGs
### Regions and genes clustered using Euclidean distance and Ward.D2


output_dir <- "02_4_Heatmap Top 5 regions x Top 10 DEGs"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Select the five regions with the highest total DEG burden
top5_regions <- deg_summary_sig_fc %>%
  arrange(desc(n_deg_total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(region)

top5_regions


# Select the top 10 significant DEGs within each region
# Ranked by adjusted p-value, then absolute log2FC
top_genes_per_region <- degs_sig_fc %>%
  filter(region %in% top5_regions) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  arrange(
    p_val_adj,
    desc(abs(avg_log2FC)),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

top_genes_per_region


# Union of selected genes
genes_keep <- unique(top_genes_per_region$gene)

length(genes_keep)
genes_keep


# Build gene × region matrix
# Significant entries retain their signed avg_log2FC
# Non-significant entries are set to NA and displayed as white
heatmap_mat <- deg_table_all %>%
  filter(
    region %in% top5_regions,
    gene %in% genes_keep
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    heatmap_log2FC = if_else(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25,
      avg_log2FC,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    region,
    heatmap_log2FC
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene,
    region,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  complete(
    gene = genes_keep,
    region = top5_regions
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = region,
    values_from = heatmap_log2FC
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()


# Transpose so regions are rows and genes are columns
heatmap_mat <- t(heatmap_mat)


# Remove genes without a significant value in any of the five regions
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  ,
  colSums(!is.na(heatmap_mat)) > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]


# Create a separate matrix for clustering
# Non-significant values are treated as zero for distance calculation
clustering_mat <- heatmap_mat
clustering_mat[is.na(clustering_mat)] <- 0


# Remove genes with no variation across regions
gene_sd <- apply(
  clustering_mat,
  2,
  sd
)

clustering_mat <- clustering_mat[
  ,
  gene_sd > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Keep display matrix synchronized
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  ,
  colnames(clustering_mat),
  drop = FALSE
]


# Check that clustering matrix contains valid values
stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(clustering_mat))
)


# Cluster regions using Euclidean distance and Ward.D2
hc_regions <- hclust(
  dist(
    clustering_mat,
    method = "euclidean"
  ),
  method = "ward.D2"
)


# Cluster genes using Euclidean distance and Ward.D2
hc_genes <- hclust(
  dist(
    t(clustering_mat),
    method = "euclidean"
  ),
  method = "ward.D2"
)


# Symmetric colour scale around zero
max_abs_fc <- max(
  abs(heatmap_mat),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(
  c("darkblue", "white", "darkred")
)(100)

heatmap_breaks <- seq(
  -max_abs_fc,
  max_abs_fc,
  length.out = 101
)


# Generate heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_mat,

  color = heatmap_colors,
  breaks = heatmap_breaks,
  na_col = "white",

  cluster_rows = hc_regions,
  cluster_cols = hc_genes,

  border_color = "grey90",

  fontsize = 8,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 7,
  angle_col = 45,

  legend = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(
    -max_abs_fc,
    0,
    max_abs_fc
  ),
  legend_labels = round(
    c(-max_abs_fc, 0, max_abs_fc),
    2
  ),

  main = "Top 10 DEGs per region",

  filename = file.path(output_dir,"top10_DEGs_top5_regions_euclidean_heatmap.pdf"),

  width = max(
    8,
    0.22 * ncol(heatmap_mat) + 2
  ),

  height = 4
)
```

```{r}
### HEATMAP: ALL REGIONS USING THE UNION OF TOP 10 DEGs
### Gene set derived from the top 5 DEG-burden regions
### Regions and genes clustered using Euclidean distance and Ward.D2


meta_qc <- experiment@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("barcode") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(region = labels, sample = sample)

complete_regions <- meta_qc %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(region), !is.na(sample)) %>%
  dplyr::count(region, sample, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(region, sample, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_samples_present = sum(n > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_samples_present == 4) %>%
  dplyr::pull(region)


# Obtain all regions represented in the complete DEG table
heatmap_regions <- deg_table_all %>%
  filter(region %in% complete_regions) %>%
  distinct(region) %>%
  pull(region)

heatmap_regions


# Build region × gene matrix
#
# Continuous signed avg_log2FC values are retained for all regions,
# regardless of whether the gene is significant in that region.
# Missing gene-region combinations are set to zero.

heatmap_all_regions <- deg_table_all %>%
  filter(region %in% complete_regions, gene %in% genes_keep) %>%
  mutate(
    heatmap_log2FC = if_else(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25,
      avg_log2FC,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    region,
    heatmap_log2FC
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene,
    region,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  complete(
    gene = genes_keep,
    region = heatmap_regions,
    fill = list(heatmap_log2FC = 0)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gene,
    values_from = heatmap_log2FC,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("region") %>%
  as.matrix()


# Check that the matrix contains only finite values
stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(heatmap_all_regions))
)


# Remove genes with no variation across regions
gene_sd <- apply(
  heatmap_all_regions,
  2,
  sd
)

heatmap_all_regions <- heatmap_all_regions[
  ,
  gene_sd > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]


# Remove regions with no variation across the selected genes
region_sd <- apply(
  heatmap_all_regions,
  1,
  sd
)

heatmap_all_regions <- heatmap_all_regions[
  region_sd > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


# Cluster regions using Euclidean distance and Ward.D2
hc_regions <- hclust(
  dist(
    heatmap_all_regions,
    method = "euclidean"
  ),
  method = "ward.D2"
)


# Cluster genes using Euclidean distance and Ward.D2
hc_genes <- hclust(
  dist(
    t(heatmap_all_regions),
    method = "euclidean"
  ),
  method = "ward.D2"
)


# Symmetric colour scale around zero
max_abs_fc <- max(
  abs(heatmap_all_regions),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(
  c("darkblue", "white", "darkred")
)(100)

heatmap_breaks <- seq(
  -max_abs_fc,
  max_abs_fc,
  length.out = 101
)


# Highlight the five regions used to define the gene signature
region_annotation <- data.frame(
  Signature_source = ifelse(
    rownames(heatmap_all_regions) %in% top5_regions,
    "Top 5 region",
    "Other region"
  )
)

rownames(region_annotation) <- rownames(heatmap_all_regions)



# Generate heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_all_regions,

  color = heatmap_colors,
  breaks = heatmap_breaks,

  cluster_rows = hc_regions,
  cluster_cols = hc_genes,

  annotation_row = region_annotation,
  
  border_color = "grey90",

  fontsize = 7,
  fontsize_row = 7,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  angle_col = 45,

  legend = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(
    -max_abs_fc,
    0,
    max_abs_fc
  ),
  legend_labels = round(
    c(-max_abs_fc, 0, max_abs_fc),
    2
  ),

  main = "All regions: projected on top-10 DEG signature",

  filename = file.path(output_dir,"all_regions_top10_DEG_signature_euclidean_heatmap.pdf"),

  width = max(
    10,
    0.22 * ncol(heatmap_all_regions) + 3
  ),

  height = max(
    7,
    0.22 * nrow(heatmap_all_regions) + 2
  )
)
```

```{r}
### SUPPLEMENTARY DEG TABLES

output_dir <- "02_5_supplementary tables DEG"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


padj_cutoff <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.25

deg_table_annotated <- deg_table_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(region %in% complete_regions) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significant = p_val_adj < padj_cutoff & abs(avg_log2FC) > logfc_cutoff
  )

# 1. DEG summary (single threshold only)
deg_summary_thresholds <- deg_table_annotated %>%
  dplyr::group_by(region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_genes_tested = sum(!is.na(p_val_adj)),
    n_deg = sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_deg = 100 * n_deg / n_genes_tested,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_deg))

write.csv(
  deg_summary_thresholds,
  file.path(output_dir,"Table_S4_DEG_summary_by_region.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 2. Full DEG table (keep as supplementary data file)
write.csv(
  deg_table_annotated,
  file.path(output_dir,"Table_S5_full_regionwise_DEG_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 3. Significant DEGs only (clean)
degs_sig_export <- deg_table_annotated %>%
  dplyr::filter(significant) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    region,
    gene,
    avg_log2FC,
    pct.1,
    pct.2,
    p_val,
    p_val_adj
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(region, p_val_adj, dplyr::desc(abs(avg_log2FC)))

write.csv(
  degs_sig_export,
  file.path(output_dir,"Table_S6_significant_DEGs.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 4. Top 10 DEGs per region (no direction split)
top_deg_per_region <- degs_sig_export %>%
  dplyr::group_by(region) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj, dplyr::desc(abs(avg_log2FC)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    region,
    rank,
    gene,
    avg_log2FC,
    pct.1,
    pct.2,
    p_val_adj
  )

write.csv(
  top_deg_per_region,
  file.path(output_dir,"Table_S7_top10_DEGs_per_region.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 5. Shared DEG table (fixed logic)
shared_deg_table <- degs_sig_export %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_regions_sig = dplyr::n_distinct(region),
    regions = paste(sort(unique(region)), collapse = ";"),
    max_abs_log2FC = max(abs(avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE),
    min_padj = min(p_val_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_regions_sig > 1) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_regions_sig), min_padj)

write.csv(
  shared_deg_table,
  file.path(output_dir,"Table_S8_shared_DEGs_across_regions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
